name: pdf
description: Read, create, inspect, render, verify, and extract PDF files with duya's pdf office skill.

interface.shortDescription: Read, create, and verify PDF files
interface.longDescription: Read, create, inspect, render, verify, and extract content from PDF files locally, including fillable AcroForm handling with widget/field-tree repair and flatten verification. Poppler rendering plus reportlab, pdfplumber, and pypdf. Use PDF when the durable output or target is a PDF file and visual layout fidelity matters.
